card.name: Opening quotes and speech lead-ins
card.fires_on: Opening quotation marks, colons or commas, and words like 'that' or 'quoted', right where a speaker's words are about to start in narrative or interview text.

modes.label: Opening quote mark
modes.description: A quotation mark that begins someone's spoken words after a speech verb or a prior line.
modes.example: He responded hurriedly but not unkindly,<< ">>Jennifer's arm is broken in several places

modes.label: Speech-introducing word
modes.description: A 'that', colon, comma or 'quoted' that leads into reported or quoted speech.
modes.example: who also noted<< that>> until now manufacturers paid more than $1

card.plain: It lights up at the point where someone's quoted words or reported speech are about to begin.
